title: 第十三章 一起睡第十四章 同床共枕
lines: 第十三章：一起睡
入夜的城市总是那么的千娇百媚，璀璨的灯火与朦胧的夜色呼应，勾兑出这座城市浓稠的魅力，它就像是一个夜场里经验老练的舞女，你不一定会爱上它，但一定会被它吸引。
中港市的区域划分很明显，南城区的夜生活最繁华，北城区的学府最多，东城区的白领阶级和写字楼最多，西城区里的工厂和外地人最多，至于居于这四大区中间的市中心，则汇聚了最多的达官显贵和富贾名流。
一连在酒吧里喝了一个星期酒的章小雅，今天晚上再没有出现在南城区，昨天晚上的事情让她害怕，至少从小到大从来都没有那么怕过，她今年十九岁，九零后的小女生，她不像大多数的九零后小女生那样性情奔放，喜欢大肆张扬的表现自己，活了十九年，她一直都很低调。
这跟家庭教育有着绝对的关系，最疼爱她的爷爷从小就教导她，这个世界上死的最快的，最容易被打脸的，都是那些喜欢臭显摆的人，而且往往越能显摆的人，其实他们的内心越是空虚自卑，所以咱做人要低调。
可能是太过低调的缘故，章小雅和她同寝的三个女孩相处的不是很融洽，黄莉莉、蒋晓珊、刘倩都是来自大城市大家庭，平时总瞧不起她，以为她就是个小地方来的土丫头，和她们根本就不是一路子的人，比如黄莉莉喜欢买名牌，说出来的大品牌章小雅听都没听过，还怎么一起玩耍？
蒋晓珊和刘倩也是一样，她们的家庭虽然不及黄莉莉，但条件也都不错，平时对出手大方的黄莉莉也一向是阿谀奉承，甘愿做她的‘小妹’。
章小雅对她们其实挺嗤之以鼻的，尤其是黄莉莉，虽然满嘴的名牌，但穿的几乎都是赝品，章小雅又不是真的不知道那些名牌，她燕京城的家里，偌大的衣柜里挂满了各种各样漂亮时尚并且前端的衣服，就是每年她捐给偏远山区的衣服，也都比黄莉莉那几件真品昂贵的多。
章小雅一向的矜持低调，不单单骗过了同寝的三个室友和周围所有的同学、老师，甚至就连跟她相恋了三年的男友，直到最后因为一个富家女而跟她分手的时候，都还不知道章小雅的‘家大业大’，那个所谓的富家女真要和章小雅比起来，给丫的提鞋都不配。
分手总是令人伤心，尤其是被甩，还是因为一个不如自己的第三者被甩，更有甚的是，那还是自己的初恋，第一次牵手，第一次拥抱，第一次接吻……
现在回想起来，倒也有些庆幸，幸好当初自己紧要关头把他从自己的身上推开了，否则的话，自己的初夜也要奉献给那个人面兽心的混蛋了。
在酒吧里喝了一个星期的酒，章小雅失声的哭过，也曾酒醉后在午夜的大街上一个人游荡，伤心与痛楚像一道带刺的枷锁，死死卡着她的心，但这一切在昨天晚上之后就都发生变化了，阴霾散去，枷锁崩碎，只因遇到了他。
当他打倒了那几个流氓，伸手把衣衫不整的她从车上救下来的时候，当他的眼神温柔而又坚定的看着她，她的眼神是那样的楚楚的时候，章小雅那支离破碎的心跳，猛然的重新恢复了旋律，就因为遇到了他！
爱情，可以死的痛哭流涕，也可以突然间天马星空一般奔袭而来……
今天白天，章小雅给远在燕京的爷爷打了个电话，她先是梨花带雨的哭了一阵，将她最近的凄惨遭遇通通诉说了一遍，然后口吻坚定的对那位京城里最低调的小老头说：“爷爷，我决定了，我以后不再低调了！”
此刻，窗外的夜色尤其的繁华，市中心的一家高档餐厅里，许多穿戴时尚有品位的人们，正坐在里面慢条斯文的享受着晚餐，章小雅也坐在里面，她选了一个靠窗的座位，眼前放了一盘简单的意大利面，和一份水果沙拉，可别小瞧了这两样东西，价格远超它们本身的价值数十倍。
章小雅一边翻看着时尚杂志，一边小口的嚼着沙拉，对面的沙发椅上摆满了精致的购物袋，她身上也换上了一套新买的某大品牌最新款的连衣裙，价码具体是多少她没看，反正是很长的一排数字，她要做的就是穿上衣服，走到试衣镜前看自己是否喜欢，然后把信用卡递给服务员。
她老老实实的坐在这儿，不是为了享受餐厅优雅的环境，而是逛街逛的累了，冷不丁的穿上十厘米的高跟鞋，那双习惯了旅游鞋的小脚还真受不了，而且她还在等一个重要的电话。
桌上的手机嗡嗡的响了起来，是新买的IP6，之前那个不到一千块的手机，被她以五十块的价格卖给了倒腾手机的小贩，电话燕京城里那位最低调的小老头打来的，章小雅马上打起了精神。
“喂，爷爷，查到了？……哦哦，我明天就要搬过去，爷爷再帮帮忙啦……嘻嘻，谢谢爷爷！”
挂了电话，章小雅脸上的兴奋无以言表，嘴角噙着一抹阳光盛般的幸福微笑，呢喃道：“嘿，我找到你了！”
办公室里的人都下班了，就连一直都是最后一个离开的保洁阿姨也下班了，偌大的办公室里一片黑漆漆的，只有销售经理的办公室里亮着灯。
楚静瑶在赶一个销售方案，这个销售方案如果做的好的话，她就可以荣升公司空缺的销售总监了，按照她的家世她本来是不用这么拼的，身为天楚集团最大的股东，即便她这辈子什么都不做，钱也是多的下辈子都花不完，可她就是想要证明自己，不用钱而是凭着自己的能力。
晚饭又没吃，实在是没什么胃口，这也是她工作的一个不好的习惯，一旦拼命工作起来，食欲就会减退，可该饿的时候肚子还是会咕咕叫，饿的胃疼了她就喝点热水捱捱。
楚静瑶敲了敲有些发酸的后背，望着窗外朦胧的夜色，喝一口热水，想着这时候要是有港记的龙虾煎饺和肉饼吃该有多好，最好再来一份肉松粥。
她脑袋里刚转过这个想法，外面办公室的玻璃门被推开了，有人点亮了大厅里的灯，她以为是某个同事有东西落下来了，结果却听到了儿子的声音。
content_en:
Chapter Thirteen: Sleeping together
The city is always so charming at night. The bright lights echo the hazy night, blending the city's strong charm. It is like an experienced dancer in a nightclub. You may not necessarily fall in love with it, but you will definitely be attracted by it.
The regional divisions of Zhonggang City are very obvious. Nancheng District has the busiest nightlife, Beicheng District has the most schools, Dongcheng District has the most white-collar workers and office buildings, Xicheng District has the most factories and foreigners, and the city center, which is in the middle of these four districts, has the largest number of dignitaries and wealthy celebrities.
Zhang Xiaoya, who had been drinking in the bar for a week, did not appear in Nancheng District again tonight. What happened last night scared her. At least she has never been so scared since she was a child. She is nineteen years old and a girl born in the 1990s. She is not as unrestrained as most girls born in the 1990s and likes to express herself in a big way. She has always been low-key in her nineteen years of life.
This has absolutely something to do with family education. Her grandfather, who loves her the most, has taught her since she was a child that the people who die the fastest in the world and are most likely to be slapped in the face are those who like to show off, and the more people can show off, the more empty and inferior they are inside, so we should be low-key.
Perhaps because she was too low-key, Zhang Xiaoya did not get along well with the three girls she slept with. Huang Lili, Jiang Xiaoshan, and Liu Qian all came from big families in big cities. They always looked down on her, thinking that she was just a local girl from a small place who was not the same as them. For example, Huang Lili liked to buy famous brands, and Zhang Xiaoya had never heard of the big brands mentioned, so how could they play together?
The same goes for Jiang Xiaoshan and Liu Qian. Although their families are not as good as Huang Lili's, their conditions are good. Huang Lili, who is usually generous, has always been flattering and willing to be her 'little sister'.
Zhang Xiaoya actually despises them, especially Huang Lili. Although she talks about famous brands, most of the clothes she wears are fakes. It's not like Zhang Xiaoya doesn't really know those famous brands. In her home in Yanjing City, the huge wardrobe is filled with all kinds of beautiful, fashionable and cutting-edge clothes. Even the clothes she donates to remote mountainous areas every year are much more expensive than Huang Lili's authentic ones.
Zhang Xiaoya has always been reserved and low-key. Not only did she deceive her three roommates and all the classmates and teachers around her, but even her boyfriend, who had been in love with her for three years, didn't even know about Zhang Xiaoya's "big family and big business" until he finally broke up with her because of a rich girl. That so-called rich girl was really not worthy of being compared to Zhang Xiaoya.
Breaking up is always sad, especially if you are dumped because of a third person who is not as good as you. What's more, it is your first love, the first time you hold hands, the first hug, the first kiss...
Looking back now, I feel a little lucky. Fortunately, I pushed him away from me at the critical moment. Otherwise, my first night would have been dedicated to that bastard with a human face and a beast heart.
After drinking in the bar for a week, Zhang Xiaoya cried silently, and also wandered alone on the street at midnight after being drunk. Sadness and pain were like a thorny shackle, clinging to her heart. But all of this changed after last night. The haze dissipated and the shackles collapsed, just because she met him.
When he knocked down those gangsters and reached out to rescue the disheveled woman from the car, when his eyes looked at her gently but firmly, and her eyes were so beautiful, Zhang Xiaoya's broken heartbeat suddenly resumed its melody, just because she met him!
Love can make you cry to death, or it can suddenly rush towards you like a horse in the sky...
During the day today, Zhang Xiaoya called her grandfather who was far away in Yanjing. She cried for a while and told her recent tragic experience. Then she said firmly to the most low-key old man in the capital: "Grandpa, I have decided that I will no longer be low-key!"
At this moment, the night outside the window was particularly prosperous. In a high-end restaurant in the city center, many fashionable and tasteful people were sitting inside, enjoying dinner slowly and elegantly. Zhang Xiaoya was also sitting inside. She chose a seat by the window and placed a plate of simple pasta and a fruit salad in front of her. Don't underestimate these two things, the price is dozens of times higher than their own value.
Zhang Xiaoya was flipping through fashion magazines and munching on salad. The sofa chair opposite was filled with exquisite shopping bags. She also put on a new set of the latest dress from a major brand. She didn't see the exact price, but it was a long row of numbers. All she had to do was put on the clothes, walk to the dressing mirror to see if she liked it, and then handed her credit card to the waiter.
She was sitting here honestly, not to enjoy the elegant environment of the restaurant, but because she was tired from shopping and suddenly put on ten-centimeter high heels. Her little feet used to traveling shoes couldn't bear it, and she was still waiting for an important call.
The mobile phone on the table buzzed. It was the newly purchased IP6 phone. The previous mobile phone cost less than a thousand yuan, which she sold to a mobile phone vendor for fifty yuan. The call came from the most low-key old man in Yanjing City. Zhang Xiaoya immediately cheered up.
"Hey, grandpa, have you found it?... Oh, I'm moving there tomorrow, grandpa can help me... Hehe, thank you grandpa!"
After hanging up the phone, the excitement on Zhang Xiaoya's face was indescribable. With a happy smile like the sun at the corner of her mouth, she murmured: "Hey, I found you!"
Everyone in the office has gotten off work, even the cleaning lady who is always the last to leave has also gotten off work. The huge office is dark, with only the sales manager's office having lights on.
Chu Jingyao is working on a sales plan. If this sales plan goes well, she can be promoted to the company's vacant sales director. According to her family background, she doesn't have to work so hard. As the largest shareholder of Tianchu Group, even if she does nothing in this life, she will have more money than she can spend in the next life. But she just wants to prove herself, not with money but with her own ability.
She didn't eat dinner, and she really had no appetite. This was also a bad habit of her work. Once she started working hard, her appetite would decrease, but her stomach would still growl when she was hungry. When her stomach hurt, she would drink some hot water to comfort herself.
Chu Jingyao slapped her sore back, looked out the window at the hazy night, took a sip of hot water, and thought about how good it would be to have Hong Kong Kee's fried lobster dumplings and meatloaf, and it would be best to have some meat floss porridge.
Just as this thought came to her mind, the glass door of the office outside was pushed open, and someone lit up the lamp in the hall. She thought it was a colleague who dropped something, but she heard her son's voice.
title_en: Chapter Thirteen: Sleeping Together Chapter Fourteen: Sharing the Same Bed
